learning_objective: 🎯 Get ready to swing! Today we will learn how to hit a ball using a bat, racket, or even our hands.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Hold your bat firmly with both hands. Stand sideways, bend your knees a little, and get ready for the ball.
Keep your eyes on the ball all the time. When it gets close, swing your bat and strike it hard to send it flying!

fun_activity.title: 🎈 Balloon Tennis
fun_activity.instructions: Use a hard book or a small plastic plate as a racket. See how many times you can strike a balloon up in the air without letting it fall!

quick_recap: ⭐ A strong grip on your bat helps you hit the ball powerfully.
⭐ Watching the ball carefully is the secret to a great strike.
